result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred cap, mutuality, carve-out, and payment-obligation positions. However, it also excludes all “Excluded Claims” from the indirect/consequential-damages waiver, whereas the playbook only expressly requires those claims to be uncapped; that expansion is not clearly necessary. Drafting is understandable but retains material source defects and awkwardness, including “LICENSORHAS,” duplicated liability language, and the grammatically strained definition of Excluded Claims.
